reviews.title: It’s a lot of fun
reviews.text:
It is fun. I wasn’t sure what to expect but I had fun and she explained it really well so I knew what I was doing and the time went by so quickly. I would 
recommend this app to anyone who wants to get fit and dance. I am glad to be doing this at home and not out in front of others. Having a lot of fun and learning some dance moves not ready for Saturday night fever lol but I feel like I am getting in better shape
Learning so well I really am enjoying this while I’m getting into shape. Sometimes I feel like doing a previous dance and I like the fact that I can do it if I want to cause most of the instruand having fun and getting into shape I can feel it
I can truthfully say I love it and I am still learning and having fun. I am in a lot better shape now and happier when I am dancing with the different instructors with the different styles.  
Thank you. My family has noticed and they say I seem stronger all around even my attitude. 
Thank you.
I am oon another dance set lol just when I thought I had the last danxe steps down it got upped on me but still learning and having fun. My grandson said “grandma your calfs are huge” and  yhat keeps pushing me on.
  Tried some new things and I am having a great time but its easy to have fun and learn new dances when you have good teachers. I still do some of the things I have already done for two reasons. The first is because I enjoy them and the second reason is to keep doing the dances so I don’t forget them and to make sure that I have the movements right.
I am still having fun and learning new moves but I like to do some of the dances that I have already done because I want to make sure I’m doing the steps right and they are fun. 
I am getting fit. My grandson said to me “ grandma your calfs are huge!” In complete amazement! Boy did that make my day, I couldn’t stop smiling.  I think I am finally getting the hang of some of the dances and not just trying to go through the motions.   I am still having fun and building my muscle and confidence. I would recommend this app for everyone. I have a bad back and joints but most of the exercises are done with people having problems and they tell you if there is something you can not do don’t worry just scale it back and keep going.  I feel better than I have felt in a long time.  Like most of the instructors say this iis for you so work hard and enjoy it.
I am learning so much like the proper way to stand and hold yourself for different exercises. I didn’t know that it mattered but if you are the moves for you and I like the saying lworking on your core you hold yourself one way but if you are working on your legs you hold your body a different angle. The dance steps are becoming more advanced and while I am learning the moves I am definitely not as graceful but I am working at it. I have met some new instructors and they are as good and likable as the first ones I met. They all break down the moves. The sayings are great “this is your workout” and “have fun with it “. I am really happy that I signed up with the hospital in Philly for test and I was doing DanceBit in the hotel room. That’s another great thing about this app is that you can do it anywhere. I love it.DanceBit.
There are days I am tired or not feeling great but I think I will do the best that I can today and the next thing I know I am getting really into it and I feel better. We were traveling, a short trip across the state
It’s been about 6 months since I started DanceBit and I still love it and I am still having fun. My grandson said’grandma your calfs are huge!’ They are defined and I love it! I worked hard for those huge calf muscles lol. My doctor was impressed the last time I was in there, October. I go back in January and he said you will have to teach me to salsa. He asked my daughter if she was going to salsa with us and she said no I am going to make it video lol. I recommend this to all. I can walk further without getting out of breath. It’s great!
I don’t remember how many months I have been dancing with DanceBit and I still love it and I am still having fun.  My family and my doctor have noticed the changes to my body and my attitude. They say I am more like my old self happy and upbeat.

I just started a new dance type today lol. I need some practice lol but iit was fun. The instructors are all great so far I have not met one I didn’t like. Recommend

reviews.title: Pay Attention to the Terms of Service
reviews.text:
$118 a month for dancing videos. This is directly from their Subscription Terms of Service:
“UNLESS YOU CANCEL YOUR TRIAL AT LEAST TWENTY-FOUR (24) HOURS BEFORE THE END OF THE TRIAL PERIOD, YOUR SELECTED PAYMENT METHOD WILL BE CHARGED THE APPLICABLE SUBSCRIPTION FEE…”
My child signed up for this for $7.99. I tried to cancel a day or so later under my subscriptions on my Apple Settings but nothing was there. A month later I was charged $118. 
When I requested a refund, their customer service team
declined and directed to their Terms of Service. Since NO ONE ever reads the Terms of Service, I thought I’d make sure more people saw it, hopefully before they sign up and get taken for $118 like I did.
